geography: Worldwide (Sanofi total net sales; line 'Soliqua' to 2022, 'Soliqua/iGlarLixi' from 2023, i.e. Soliqua in the US and Suliqua elsewhere)
moa: Basal insulin analogue plus GLP-1 receptor agonist (fixed-ratio combination)

launch_evidence.quote: Soliqua™100/33, first once-daily fixed combination of Lantus ® and lixisenatide for type-2 diabetes, launched in the U.S.

search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1121404 (Sanofi) from data.sec.gov/submissions including the older 'files' pages. Candidate results filings: every 6-K/6-K/A from 2009 on, filed 20 Jan-28 Feb, 15 Apr-12 May, 15 Jul-12 Aug or 15 Oct-12 Nov, with total filing size >= 250 KB; each candidate's index.json was read and every exhibit between 20 KB and 4 MB was fetched and searched for Multaq, Jevtana, Lemtrada, Soliqua, Zaltrap, Rezurock and Xenpozyme (XBRL R pages, the 20-F-style half-year XBRL documents and the 6-K cover pages excluded from selection).

Each candidate exhibit's quarter was read from the header of the net-sales tables that print the products (e.g. 'Q3 2010 net sales', 'Q2 2024 (€ million)'); per quarter the exhibit with most product rows is the quarterly results press release. Header detection failed for 2009Q3/2009Q4 (header 'Millions of euros / 2009 Q3 net sales') and mislabelled the 2012Q2 release (its table header misprints 'Q2 2011 net sales'; the figures are the 2012 quarter, the year 2012 is in the release); those were set by hand, and for 2021Q1 and 2025Q3 Sanofi's own 6-K press release (pressreleaseq12021english.htm, pressreleaseq32025english.htm) was preferred over a later 6-K re-filing of the same release.

Row selection: the first table in the release that prints the product (the franchise summary 'Net sales (€ million) / Qn YYYY / Change at CER', or from 2023/2024 the 'Qn YYYY (€ million) / Total Sales / % CER / ... United States / Europe / Rest of World' table whose first column is the worldwide total). In 2016-2019 the appendix splits sales into 'Total GBUs' (excluding Emerging Markets) and 'Total Franchises' (worldwide); where a product prints only in that appendix (Multaq 2016Q1-2018Q2), the Total Franchises column is recorded. Units as declared beside each table: '€ million' / 'millions of euros'.

Row label 'Soliqua ®' (2017Q1-2022Q4) then 'Soliqua/iGlarLixi' (2023Q1 on, the same product under its EU name Suliqua and generic shorthand iGlarLixi); the 2022 and 2023 totals continue smoothly (55 in Q4 2022, 63 in Q1 2023).
